% standalone preview wrapper for plots generated by experiments/plot.py --tikz
%
% Run as:
%   pdflatex -jobname=output/ne12-01-conv-trace experiments/plot.tex
% which reads output/ne12-01-conv-trace.tex (+ its .csv) and writes
% output/ne12-01-conv-trace.pdf next to them.
%
% Override compile-time macros via \def injection if needed:
%   pdflatex "\def\figurewidth{6cm}\input{experiments/plot.tex}" -jobname=output/foo

\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=newest}

\providecommand{\figurewidth}{12cm}

% Split \jobname into directory + base so \plotdatadir points to the
% directory where the .tex (and .csv) live. \filename@parse sets
% \filename@area to "output/" when \jobname is "output/foo".
\makeatletter
\filename@parse{\jobname}
\providecommand{\plotdatadir}{\filename@area}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\input{\jobname.tex}
\end{document}
